age.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (Harlan Industries, Indianapolis, IN, USA; initial weight 250-275 g)

dosing.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT (0, 0.1, or 1.0 mg/kg)... All drugs were administered subcutaneously (SC) in a volume of 1 mL/kg. 5-MeO-DMT... dissolved in isotonic saline.

handling.evidence: One day before the study, animals were taken to the BPM testing room, weighed, handled briefly

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h reverse light-dark cycle (lights off at 0700 h)

assays.assay_description: Startle chambers (SR-LAB) measuring startle magnitude and %PPI 45 min after 5-MeO-DMT injection, with or without MAOI (pargyline/clorgyline) pretreatment and 5-HT1A (WAY-100,635) or 5-HT2A (MDL 11,939) antagonist pretreatment.

setup_habituation.evidence: One week after arrival, animals were tested in a brief startle/PPI session to create treatment groups matched for baseline levels of startle and PPI.

setup_restrain.evidence: clear nonrestrictive cylindrical Plexiglas stabilimeter, 8.2 cm in diameter

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

time_to_assay.evidence: Animals were placed in the startle chambers 45 min after treatment with 5-MeO-DMT.

sample_size.evidence: Experiment 1: n = 10/group, 60 total. Experiment 2: n = 12/group, 48 total. Experiment 3: n = 10/group, 60 total.

outcomes.summary: 5-MeO-DMT (1 mg/kg) alone did not alter PPI at 45 min post-injection, but it significantly disrupted PPI in rats pretreated with the MAOIs pargyline or clorgyline. The MAOI+5-MeO-DMT-induced PPI disruption was antagonized by both the 5-HT1A antagonist WAY-100,635 and the 5-HT2A antagonist MDL 11,939.
outcomes.statistics: Pargyline x 5-MeO-DMT interaction F(2,54)=17.59, p<0.0001; Clorgyline x 5-MeO-DMT interaction F(1,44)=24.74, p<0.0001; WAY-100,635 antagonism F(1,36)=73.11, p<0.0001; MDL 11,939 antagonism F(1,36)=23.96, p<0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: 5-MeO-DMT did not alter PPI in saline-pretreated animals but significantly reduced PPI in animals pretreated with pargyline... The reduction of PPI produced by 10 mg/kg pargyline and 1 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT was significantly antagonized by pretreatment with 1 mg/kg WAY-100,635... The ability of pargyline and 5-MeO-DMT to reduce PPI was significantly attenuated by pretreatment with MDL 11,939.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Startle magnitude, %PPI, and NOSTIM (spontaneous motor activity) were measured.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: PPI data... average PPI was used as the main dependent measure.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported.

B5_social.evidence: Animals were tested alone in the startle chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: PPI is an innate sensorimotor gating response, not learned.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: SR-LAB system using a piezoelectric accelerometer (signal amplitude).

E2_shelter.evidence: Clear nonrestrictive cylindrical Plexiglas stabilimeter — no shelter.

E7_social_context.evidence: Focal animal tested alone in the startle chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

D1_continuity.evidence: One week after arrival, animals were tested in a brief startle/PPI session to create treatment groups matched for baseline... Animals were placed in the startle chambers 45 min after treatment with 5-MeO-DMT.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5-min acclimation + three blocks of trials (5 PULSE-ALONE + 12 PULSE-ALONE and 30 PREPULSE+PULSE + 5 PULSE-ALONE) with ~15 s ITI; total session ~20 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Baseline matching startle/PPI session one week after arrival, plus the experimental test day.

D4_baseline.evidence: One week after arrival, animals were tested in a brief startle/PPI session to create treatment groups matched for baseline levels of startle and PPI.

assays.assay_description: 30.5 x 61.0 x 28.0 cm black Plexiglas chamber with 4x8 photobeam grid, holes in walls/floor, and touchplates. Locomotor crossings analyzed in 10-min blocks after clorgyline (0.3 mg/kg) or vehicle pretreatment plus 1 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT; recording for up to 60 min.

setup_habituation.evidence: One day before the study, animals were taken to the BPM testing room, weighed, handled briefly, placed in a clear Plexiglas box (24 x 46 cm) for approximately 30 s.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals freely moving in the BPM chamber.

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

time_to_assay.evidence: The animals were placed in the BPM chambers 10 min after 5-MeO-DMT treatment.

sample_size.evidence: Rats were divided into two groups (n = 30/group)... locomotor activity was monitored for 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, or 60 min (n = 5/time point/group).

outcomes.summary: Clorgyline (0.3 mg/kg) pretreatment significantly potentiated the locomotor response to 1 mg/kg 5-MeO-DMT, with clorgyline-pretreated rats making more crossings than vehicle-pretreated rats during the fifth 10-min block (i.e., 40-50 min post-injection), confirming delayed hyperactivity.
outcomes.statistics: Main effect of clorgyline F(1,48)=7.25, p<0.01; clorgyline x time block interaction F(5,48)=3.64, p<0.008; fifth 10-min block p<0.05 (Bonferroni).
outcomes.evidence: rats pretreated with clorgyline made significantly more crossings (a measure of locomotor activity) during the fifth 10-min time block (p<0.05, Bonferroni's test), confirming the animals were hyperactive.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Locomotor activity was quantified by the number of crossings between any of eight equal square sectors within the BPM.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data were examined in 10-min time blocks.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only crossings analyzed; though hole-pokes/rears are detected by apparatus, they were not reported here.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Infrared photobeam grid tracks position (beam-break system).

E1_environment_type.evidence: 30.5 x 61.0 x 28.0 cm black Plexiglas chamber (BPM).

E2_shelter.evidence: Open Plexiglas chamber, no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: Plexiglas floor with photobeams/holes; no bedding mentioned.

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (except during behavioral testing).

D1_continuity.evidence: Each animal was recorded once in the BPM.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Locomotor activity was monitored for 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, or 60 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Testing was performed on a single day per animal.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug BPM baseline recording reported.

D5_followup.evidence: No recording >=24 h after drug administration.

judge_notes: Identified two behavioural assays: Prepulse Inhibition (PPI/acoustic startle) and Behavioral Pattern Monitor (locomotor activity). LC-MS/MS pharmacokinetic measurements are not behavioural and were excluded.

Merged all PPI experiments (pargyline+5-MeO-DMT, clorgyline+5-MeO-DMT, WAY-100,635/MDL 11,939 antagonist studies) into a single PPI assay per rubric rules (same apparatus + same outcome, only pharmacological manipulations differ).

PPI setup_restrain set to 'no' per rubric: although rubric lists 'PPI startle chambers with body-restraint tubes' as restraint, the paper explicitly describes a 'clear nonrestrictive cylindrical Plexiglas stabilimeter' — overrode gptoss's 'yes'.

PPI D1 scored 1 (multiple sessions) and D3 scored 1 (2-7 days) because the paper explicitly reports a baseline startle/PPI matching session one week after arrival, with data used to assign groups; D4 (baseline) also scored 1.
time_to_assay value set to acute_0to2h (45 min < 2 h) — overrode gptoss's 'early_2to24h' which was incorrect.
BPM B4 scored 0: although holepokes/rears are detected by apparatus, only crossings (locomotor) were analyzed and reported as result.
